# Phrases that describe superseded decisions. The "Check docs for stale
# claims" job in checks.yaml fails when any repo doc outside docs/adr/
# contains one (case-insensitive, fixed-string match). ADRs are exempt
# because they quote the positions they replace.
#
# One phrase per line; blank lines and lines starting with # are ignored.
# Add a phrase when an ADR supersedes a claim the docs used to make.

# ADR-0005: Connect RPC ships alongside REST.
REST-only
gRPC explicitly deferred
gRPC deferred

# ADR-0006: host resource ceilings replace "no compute limits".
not limited by design
no compute limits
does not cap a plugin's CPU

# Plugins read event history through host-events::read-events.
no history access

# The engine clock seam (oxidhome_core::clock) gives the test host a
# virtual clock.
no clock injection
